errors.quote: the overhead is $O(e^{\tau(1+c/\beta)}+1)=O(e^\lambda)$ for a fixed $\lambda<1$ above $\sigma$ and $\tau$
errors.problem: Requiring \lambda>\tau is not enough. Since c>0, \tau(1+c/\beta)>\tau, so the equality needs \lambda>\tau(1+c/\beta). The paper imposes this separately, both in the unrolling and as a hypothesis of Proposition prop:simultaneous-layer. With the fixed values, \tau(1+c/\beta)<1-31\cdot2^{-55}<\lambda.

errors.quote: A chain passes through all $s$ children, not $s/W$ of them
errors.problem: The paper does not say a chain passes through every child. It concatenates all gates and all s edge calls of an invocation "to obtain a conservative bound". Also, the time recurrence's factor s/W does not count s/W children: it is s calls, each on volume V/W ("The factor 1/W in the earlier time recurrence accounted for their smaller stream volumes").

errors.quote: To keep row counts divisible by $W$
errors.problem: Divisibility by W covers only one split. The paper pads to a multiple of W^{k_0} with k_0=\lceil\log_m d\rceil, using R_row=2^{q_0K}\ge W^{k_0}, so that at every recursive depth j\le k_0 the row count is divisible by W^{k_0-j}.
